## Magus Wraith (CR 10)

**XP** 9,600  
LE Medium undead (incorporeal)  
**Init** +7; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., lifesense; Perception +10  
**Aura** unnatural aura (30 ft.)  


**Defense**


**AC** 24, touch 18, flat-footed 14 (+5 deflection, +3 Dex)  
**hp** 117 (15d8+50)  
**Fort** +6, **Ref** +4, **Will** +9  
**Defensive Abilities** channel resistance +4, incorporeal; **Immune** undead traits  
**Weaknesses** sunlight powerlessness  


**Offense**


**Speed** fly 60 ft. (good)  
**Melee** incorporeal touch +3 (2d6 negative energy plus 1d6 Con drain)  


**Statistics**


Str—; **Dex** 16, Con —; **Int** 19; **Wis** 16; **Cha** 17  
**Base Atk** +3; **CMB** +6; **CMD** 21  
**Feats** Blind-Fight, Combat Reflexes, Improved Initiative, Improved Natural Armor  
**Skills** Diplomacy +8, Fly +7, Intimidate +11, Knowledge (magic) +19, Perception +13, Sense Motive +8, Stealth +11  
**Languages** Common  


**Special Abilities**


**Spellcasting** A magus wraith casts spells as a 15rd-level necromancer (wizard).  

**Constitution Drain (Su)** Creatures hit by a magus wraith’s touch attack must succeed on a DC 20 Fortitude save or take 1d6 points of Constitution drain. On each successful attack, the magus wraith gains 5 temporary hit points. The save DC is Charisma-based.  

**Lifesense (Su)** A magus wraith notices and locates living creatures within 60 feet, just as if it possessed the blindsight ability.  

**Sunlight Powerlessness (Ex)** A magus wraith caught in sunlight cannot attack and is staggered.  

**Unnatural Aura (Su)** Animals do not willingly approach within 30 feet of a magus wraith, unless a master makes a DC 25 Handle Animal, Ride, or wild empathy check.  


**Ecology**


**Environment** any  
**Organization** solitary  
**Treasure** standard
